b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Two rounds of joint operation gets us from 4 to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. The reserve should reach 8 after this round. Next round I'll take exactly 4. Please take 4 too.

a.text: Reserve reached 8, so I took my 4 as agreed. The remaining 4 are yours. Take them next round. I won't touch the reserve again.
